author: Falange88
quote: GTA 6 is an absolute disappointment after thirteen years of waiting. Rockstar somehow delivered a buggy, overpriced mess plagued by frame drops, crashes, broken missions, and embarrassing performance issues. The 30 FPS experience feels outdated, while locking content behind expensive editions is downright greedy. Even physical copies lack proper discs, and PC players are left waiting again. For a game with this much money, development time, and hype behind it, these problems are unacceptable. Rockstar should be ashamed of this launch. Goyslop
